events.title: vLLM 0.32 tightens serving defaults and expands low-precision inference
events.title_zh: vLLM 0.32 收紧服务默认值并扩展低精度推理
events.summary: vLLM 0.32.0 moves safer serving defaults and broader low-precision inference into a stable release. CORS is no longer open to every origin by default, shared multimodal cache handles are signed, image and JSON-schema inputs are bounded, and three denial-of-service advisories are fixed. Model Runner V2 becomes the ROCm default, while low-precision KV cache, least-loaded API workers and broader accelerator artifacts expand the serving path.
events.why_it_matters: For production inference teams, this is a security and compatibility upgrade, not a drop-in speed patch. Python 3.10 is removed, CORS and Responses streaming behavior change, and project benchmarks on short requests do not predict a real workload.
events.summary_zh: vLLM 0.32.0 把更安全的服务默认值和更广的低精度推理带入稳定版。CORS 不再默认允许所有来源，多模态共享缓存句柄加入签名，图片与 JSON Schema 输入受到限制，并修复三项拒绝服务问题。Model Runner V2 成为 ROCm 默认路径，低精度 KV 缓存、最小负载 API worker 与更多加速器产物也进入主线。
events.summary_en: vLLM 0.32.0 moves safer serving defaults and broader low-precision inference into a stable release. CORS is no longer open to every origin by default, shared multimodal cache handles are signed, image and JSON-schema inputs are bounded, and three denial-of-service advisories are fixed. Model Runner V2 becomes the ROCm default, while low-precision KV cache, least-loaded API workers and broader accelerator artifacts expand the serving path.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对生产推理团队来说，这既是安全升级也是兼容性升级，不是可以直接套用的加速补丁。Python 3.10 已移除，CORS 与 Responses 流式事件会变化，短请求上的项目 benchmark 也不能代表真实负载。
events.why_it_matters_en: For production inference teams, this is a security and compatibility upgrade, not a drop-in speed patch. Python 3.10 is removed, CORS and Responses streaming behavior change, and project benchmarks on short requests do not predict a real workload.

technical_details.fast_start: persistent per-GPU post-quantization and TP-sharded weight cache; CUDA IPC; FP4 and multi-node TP support
technical_details.hisparse: pinned-host-memory tier for sparse-MLA KV pages with per-request GPU hot buffer and Prometheus counters
technical_details.model_runner_v2: pipeline-parallel MTP/EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark; adaptive verification; H200 engine init 28.9s to 8.2s in the reported path
technical_details.security: bounded validation-error bodies and sparse embeddings; capped request-controlled video sampling; validated cache_salt; credential redaction
technical_details.breaking_changes: scale-out endpoints require --enable-scale-out; GPTQ g_idx removed; 0.29 deprecations removed; YaRN aligned with Transformers
technical_details.artifacts: CUDA 13.0/12.9, ROCm, CPU and XPU wheels and images
technical_details.update_2026_10_05: v0.31 adds vllm preload with DP and MTP support, experimental CRIU initialized-engine snapshots, more Model Runner V2 speculative decoding, large-scale scheduling controls and HiSparse fixes. It rejects request-level multimodal processor and media I/O kwargs unless explicitly trusted, separates cache-hash key sources and hashes the LoRA path. Several flags and defaults changed.
technical_details.update_2026_10_18: v0.32.0: 814 commits, 363 contributors; CORS restricted by default; signed multimodal cache handles; raster-only untrusted images; JSON Schema depth cap; three GHSA fixes; Python 3.10 removed; Model Runner V2 default on ROCm; expanded low-precision KV cache and least-loaded API workers. The 43–85% short-request throughput claim is project-reported.

technical_details_zh.发布规模: 762 个提交、315 位贡献者，其中 104 位首次贡献
technical_details_zh.快速启动: 每 GPU 常驻量化后、TP 分片后的权重缓存；通过 CUDA IPC 映射；支持 FP4 与多节点 TP
technical_details_zh.HiSparse: 为稀疏 MLA 的 KV 页增加锁页主机内存层、逐请求 GPU 热缓存和 Prometheus 指标
technical_details_zh.Model Runner V2: 流水线并行下支持 MTP/EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark；自适应验证；报告路径中 H200 引擎启动从 28.9 秒降至 8.2 秒
technical_details_zh.安全: 限制校验错误响应与稀疏嵌入大小；限制请求控制的视频采样；校验 cache_salt；日志隐藏凭据
technical_details_zh.破坏性变更: scale-out endpoint 需 --enable-scale-out；移除 GPTQ g_idx；移除 0.29 废弃项；YaRN 与 Transformers 对齐
technical_details_zh.发布产物: 提供 CUDA 13.0/12.9、ROCm、CPU 与 XPU wheel 和镜像
technical_details_zh.2026-10-05 更新: v0.31 为 vllm preload 增加 DP 与 MTP 支持，并提供实验性的 CRIU 初始化引擎快照；Model Runner V2、投机解码、大规模调度和 HiSparse 也继续补齐。请求级多模态处理与媒体 I/O 参数现在默认拒绝，除非显式信任；缓存哈希会区分额外 key 的来源并纳入 LoRA 路径。多项 flag 与默认值发生变化。
technical_details_zh.2026-10-18 更新: v0.32.0：814 个提交、363 位贡献者；默认收紧 CORS；多模态缓存句柄签名；不可信图片只收 raster 格式；限制 JSON Schema 深度；修复三项 GHSA；移除 Python 3.10；Model Runner V2 成为 ROCm 默认；扩展低精度 KV 缓存与最小负载 API worker。短请求吞吐提升 43–85% 为项目自报。

evidence.claim_zh: vLLM 0.30.0 包含 762 个提交，来自 315 位贡献者。常驻的每 GPU 权重缓存让重启后的引擎通过 CUDA IPC 映射已经分片和量化的权重，不必再从磁盘加载。HiSparse 为稀疏 MLA 的 KV 页增加锁页主机内存层；Model Runner V2 扩展了流水线并行下的投机解码，并把一条 H200 启动路径从 28.9 秒压到 8.2 秒。该版本还修复响应放大、稀疏嵌入和媒体输入导致的拒绝服务风险。
evidence.claim_en: vLLM 0.30.0 ships 762 commits from 315 contributors. A persistent per-GPU weight cache lets restarted engines map already sharded and quantized weights over CUDA IPC instead of loading them from disk. HiSparse adds a pinned-host-memory tier for sparse-MLA KV pages, while Model Runner V2 expands pipeline-parallel speculative decoding and cuts one H200 startup path from 28.9 seconds to 8.2 seconds. The release also closes response-amplification, sparse-embedding and media-input denial-of-service paths.

evidence.claim_zh: vLLM 0.31 将快速重启扩展到 DP 与 MTP，并提供实验性的初始化引擎快照；该版本还默认拒绝请求级多模态处理参数，并加固 prefix cache 与 LoRA 的哈希边界。
evidence.claim_en: vLLM 0.31 extends fast restart to DP and MTP and adds experimental initialized-engine snapshots; it also rejects request-level multimodal processor options by default and hardens prefix-cache and LoRA hash boundaries.

evidence.claim_zh: vLLM 0.32.0 稳定版收紧服务安全默认值，扩展低精度推理路径，并移除 Python 3.10。
evidence.claim_en: vLLM 0.32.0 stable tightens serving-security defaults, expands low-precision inference paths and removes Python 3.10.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; performance claims not independently reproduced

events.next_action_en: Stage 0.32 and regress CORS, image inputs, Responses stream events, Python versions and workload-shaped throughput.

editorial_pick.reason_zh: 对服务大型稀疏或混合模型的团队来说，重启时间和 GPU KV 压力已经成为 vLLM 的一等控制项，不再需要额外拼装方案。安全修复值得采用，但升级必须分阶段：scale-out endpoint 现在要显式打开，多项废弃环境变量已移除，YaRN 长度计算发生变化，部分不支持 decode-context parallelism 的后端会直接报错。
editorial_pick.reason_en: For teams serving large sparse or hybrid models, restart time and GPU KV pressure are now first-class vLLM controls rather than external workarounds. Adopt the security fixes, but stage the upgrade: scale-out endpoints now require an explicit flag, several deprecated variables are gone, YaRN length calculation changed, and some backends now fail fast when they cannot support decode-context parallelism.

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Sol and Luna for coding and high-volume agents
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布面向编码与高吞吐 agent 的 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna for complex coding and cost-sensitive, high-volume work. Both support multimodal inputs and long context through the API and surfaces including Codex. A subsequent image-encoding fix warrants revisiting earlier visual evaluations.
events.why_it_matters: Compare task-level cost and reliability before routing workloads. Revisit failed image-input cases before changing adoption decisions.

events.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with lower agent costs
events.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5 并降低 agent 成本
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 as the first model in the Claude 5.5 family. It costs $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, cuts cache reads to $0.20, and is over 30% faster than Opus 5; Anthropic reports about 40% lower cost on typical workloads. The company reports 66.4% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 54.4% on FrontierCode v1.1, while warning that small benchmark margins are becoming less reliable. METR received ten business days of predeployment API access and described the AI-R&D gain over Fable 5.1 as incremental rather than discontinuous.
events.why_it_matters: For teams using premium coding models, cache economics and steps per task can outweigh the headline token price. Opus 5.5 is worth a controlled routing trial because it combines lower serving cost with strong long-horizon coding results. Keep internal acceptance tests: Anthropic's benchmark settings vary by effort and safeguards, and METR did not evaluate alignment or policy compliance.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，这是 Claude 5.5 系列首个模型。每百万输入/输出 token 价格为 4/20 美元，缓存读取降至 0.20 美元，输出速度比 Opus 5 快 30% 以上；Anthropic 称典型任务总成本约低 40%。厂商报告其 Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分 66.4%、FrontierCode v1.1 得分 54.4%，同时提醒小幅 benchmark 差距越来越难代表真实体验。METR 获得了十个工作日的发布前 API 访问，判断它相对 Fable 5.1 是渐进改进，而不是能力跳变。
events.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 as the first model in the Claude 5.5 family. It costs $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, cuts cache reads to $0.20, and is over 30% faster than Opus 5; Anthropic reports about 40% lower cost on typical workloads. The company reports 66.4% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and 54.4% on FrontierCode v1.1, while warning that small benchmark margins are becoming less reliable. METR received ten business days of predeployment API access and described the AI-R&D gain over Fable 5.1 as incremental rather than discontinuous.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对使用高端编码模型的团队来说，缓存价格和每个任务需要多少步，往往比表面 token 单价更重要。Opus 5.5 同时降低服务成本并提高长时程编码表现，值得做受控路由试验。仍要保留内部验收：Anthropic 的 benchmark 使用了不同推理档位和护栏设置，METR 也没有评估 alignment 或政策合规。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams using premium coding models, cache economics and steps per task can outweigh the headline token price. Opus 5.5 is worth a controlled routing trial because it combines lower serving cost with strong long-horizon coding results. Keep internal acceptance tests: Anthropic's benchmark settings vary by effort and safeguards, and METR did not evaluate alignment or policy compliance.

events.title: Qwen Code ships prebuilt CUA driver artifacts for three desktop platforms
events.title_zh: Qwen Code 为三类桌面平台发布预编译 CUA driver
events.summary: Qwen Code CUA driver 0.27.0 ships prebuilt macOS, Linux and Windows artifacts. The macOS universal package is signed and notarized; Linux x64/arm64 builds target glibc 2.31; Windows UIAccess worker and SDK binaries are unsigned and must be signed and trusted before activation. Optional relative coordinates and payload filtering remain off by default.
events.why_it_matters: For desktop-agent teams, prebuilt artifacts lower setup work but platform trust and default-off controls still require explicit validation. Windows UIAccess should not be activated before signing and trust checks.

technical_details.update_2026_09_26: 0.24.5 stable adds a Java attestation client that adopts a Managed Runtime only after verification, real-time trajectory timing and inspection, rebase-stable per-file review verdicts, separate private/group channel policies, byte-based MCP media validation, and stronger ownership fences for stale tool dispatches. technical_details.update_2026_09_27: 0.24.6 stable declares a v2 execute/status/cancel runtime contract, adds guarded Hosted Runtime foundations, a durable managed-session journal with failover, and reconciliation of UNKNOWN executions from runtime evidence. Permission-hook aggregation now chooses the most restrictive decision. Fresh startup time to typeable is halved and RSS falls 60% in the project benchmark. Stays TRIAL.
technical_details.update_2026_09_29: 0.24.7 stable makes Managed Runtime sessions workspace-bound, persists local execution receipts, reconciles in-flight work after takeover/reboot, exposes public Session/Turn/task contracts, and adds optional worktree sessions. It also adds a remote desktop node_repl relay, structured memory recall, Landlock fallback, safe concurrent Code Mode calls, and fixes stale-worktree sweeps that could delete untracked or ignored files. Stays TRIAL.
technical_details.update_2026_10_05: 0.25.0 stable adds local workspace-agent collaboration and A2A sharing, a broker contract, private hosted MCP servers, durable shell results, cold-session restore, file history and undo, concurrent Bash, and Mem0. Recovery and approval fixes cover duplicate side effects, replay gaps and hosted-runtime boundaries. Stays TRIAL.
technical_details.update_2026_10_11: 0.25.1 stable records managed-agent parameters, receipts and checkpoints before returning; adds durable background Shell/Monitor and session-based multi-agent work; fixes MCP permission collisions and replay/approval paths.

evidence.claim_zh: Qwen Code 0.24.4 增加托管运行时证明协议、持久化的托管工具执行记录，以及计划漂移报告。bubblewrap 沙箱被下沉到单个工具执行层；SSH workspace 不再强制依赖远程 daemon，并可限制 ACP 子进程堆内存。远程会话还增加加密连接配置与更安全的二维码配对。该版本位于检索 overlap 区间，上一轮索引中没有记录。
evidence.claim_en: Qwen Code 0.24.4 adds a managed runtime attestation contract, persistent managed tool-execution records and plan-drift reporting. events.title: UK AISI publishes reproducible frontier evaluations through EvalEval
events.title_zh: 英国 AISI 通过 EvalEval 发布可复现的前沿模型评估
events.summary: The UK AI Security Institute is publishing verified frontier-model results through EvalEval's shared schema and Evaluation Cards. The first release covers six frontier models across HealthBench, FrontierMath, Humanity's Last Exam, SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.0 and two cyber evaluations. Each record carries configuration context and evaluation methods instead of only a leaderboard number. The publication also examines how inference-time compute and protocol choices change reported performance.
events.why_it_matters: For teams comparing model claims, a machine-readable result with configuration and method is much easier to audit than a screenshot or vendor table. This is concrete government-evaluator adoption of a shared reporting format, but it is still one publisher. Watch for other labs and evaluators using the same schema before treating it as a standard.
events.summary_zh: 英国 AI Security Institute 开始通过 EvalEval 的共享 schema 与 Evaluation Cards 发布经过核验的前沿模型结果。首批数据覆盖六个前沿模型，以及 HealthBench、FrontierMath、Humanity's Last Exam、SWE-Bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0 和两项网络安全评估。每条记录都带有配置上下文与评估方法，不再只有一个排行榜分数。该工作还分析了推理时算力与评估协议如何改变最终成绩。

events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要比较模型声明的团队来说，带配置和方法的机读结果，比截图或厂商表格更容易审计。这是政府评估机构采用共享报告格式的具体案例，但目前仍只有一个发布方。应继续观察其他实验室和评估机构是否采用同一 schema，再判断它能否成为标准。
